en.title: PRO Skidki — supermarket deals across Georgia on a website, in Telegram and on a map
en.lead: A service for people living in Georgia who don’t want to visit five shops to find the cheapest milk. Chain promotions come from the government price portal ekalata.gov.ge: the site shows where a product is cheaper right now, the Telegram bot watches the things you buy, and the map points to the nearest shop. The interface is in Russian, and search also understands English and Georgian.
points: About 1,300 deals: groceries, household and personal care from 16 supermarket chains; electronics from Zoommer, Alta, Elit and Kontakt are in the works
3,193 shops in 95 cities on the map: tap a pin for that chain’s deals, the address and a route; a “Nearest to me” button
An honest price per kg, litre or piece: pack sizes are checked against the label, sorting uses the real price
Telegram bot @pro_skidki_georgia_bot: search, “Watch” a product, a morning digest, your own shops
Channel t.me/pro_skidki_georgia with automatic posts: top deals of the day, “where it’s cheaper” by weekday, new deals, chain booklets

A storefront by section, sorted by best value, with a minimum discount filter
“My shops”: switched-off chains disappear from the feed, search and map; “Favourites” ♥
Product window: old and new price, price per unit, deal dates, “Where to buy” and a link to the shop
Works in the browser on phone and desktop, no sign-up
Bot and channel
Digests as images: photo, old/new price, pack size, price per kg or litre, chain and end date
Alerts about a new deal or a price drop — without repeats
“Near me” by location (coordinates aren’t stored) and the map right inside Telegram
